releases.title: The Reef Knot
releases.theme: Creating strong, reliable connections and making complex operations simple
releases.description: A release focused on creating strong, reliable connections and making complex operations simple. This update expands our provider ecosystem and introduces powerful migration tools to future-proof your Voice AI infrastructure.
releases.metaphor: A 'reef knot' is one of the most fundamental and reliable knots in sailing – two lines joining together with equal strength, creating a secure connection that's both easy to tie and easy to untie when needed. Just as the reef knot creates a reliable bond between two different lines, Knot-5.0 seamlessly connects multiple Voice AI providers while giving you the flexibility to adapt and migrate as your business grows.

releases.title: The Surge Splice
releases.theme: Complete end-to-end white-label SaaS solution with comprehensive billing infrastructure
releases.description: Our first major feature release that transforms Knotie-AI Pro into a complete end-to-end white-label SaaS solution! This release marks a pivotal moment in our journey, delivering the comprehensive billing and payment infrastructure you need to truly run your Voice AI Agency as your own business.
releases.metaphor: A 'surge splice' in sailing is a strong, reinforced connection made when joining two ropes together to handle sudden, intense forces – like a surge of wind or waves. Just as this splice strengthens the rigging for powerful conditions, Knot-4.0 reinforces our platform to handle the surge of growth your Voice AI Agency will experience.
releases.milestone: Traffic Surge Milestone: We experienced an incredible surge this week – 76,000 requests in a single day and over 873,000 requests in 7 days! This unexpected growth tested our infrastructure and led to some temporary rate limiting, but we've scaled up to handle 10M+ requests per month.
